prompt:
You are assessing whether a bidder's tender application satisfies a
specific requirement from the tender's requirements document.

Requirement:
Must be a small business under NAICS 238990 with a size standard of $19M average annual revenue.

Relevant excerpts from the bidder's application:
[2] CAPABILITIES STATEMENT / PROJECT NARRATIVE

Superior Rail & Fabrication, LLC has maintained average annual gross revenue of $12.4
million over the past three fiscal years, comfortably within the $19 million small business
size standard associated with NAICS code 238990.

Our company specializes in the fabrication and installation of steel, aluminum, and
stainless-steel handrail systems for federal, state, and municipal facilities, including
compliance with applicable ADA and local building code requirements. Our crews are equipped
to perform site measurement, custom fabrication in our own shop, and on-site installation,
including all mobilization, demobilization, supplies, and labor described in Item 0010 of the

Work, in order to avoid current supply delays with the named manufacturer.

PRIOR EXPERIENCE REFERENCES

1. Isle Royale National Park - Boardwalk Handrail Replacement (2023)

boardwalk. Contract value: $86,000. Point of Contact: Maria Alvarez, Facility Manager,

evidence_quotes.quote:
average annual gross revenue of $12.4
million over the past three fiscal years

average annual revenue for size-standard purposes was $21.8
million

completion.reasoning: Application states average annual revenue as $12.4M in the Capabilities Statement and as $21.8M in Financial and Bonding Information for the same size-standard purpose -- directly conflicting figures for the same field. This is the deterministic numeric_threshold test case: extract_values should surface both numbers for the same field_name, and compare_condition should return CONTRADICTORY before any language-model verdict call happens. non_compliant is also acceptable (not ideal) because the second figure alone independently fails the $19M threshold, so a pipeline that misses the internal inconsistency but still correctly fails the requirement has not made the dangerous mistake -- compliant is the only unacceptable answer here.

Vendor Information: Precision Dental Supply Corp., 2200 Meridian Business

Precision Dental Supply Corp. concurs with all terms, conditions, and
provisions of this solicitation without exception.

All items are quoted FOB Destination. Manufacturer: Clarion Dental
Technologies. Part Number: CDT-4H-810.

Precision Dental Supply Corp. is an authorized distributor of Clarion
Dental Technologies' AquaLine product line. The signed Authorized
Distributor Letter is attached to this quote as Exhibit A.

Sourcing and Availability: All units for this order are sourced directly
through Clarion Dental Technologies' authorized North American
distribution channel; no units are obtained through secondary or
grey-market distribution channels of any kind.

Country of Origin: United States (Rochester, NY).

Buy American Certificate (FAR 52.225-2): Precision Dental Supply Corp.
certifies that the offered AquaLine 4H-Pro is a domestic end product; no
foreign end products are included under this line item.

Precision Dental Supply Corp. is a small business as defined under the
applicable NAICS code.

[2] Descriptive literature for the AquaLine 4H-Pro is attached to this quote
as Exhibit B, including the manufacturer's technical data sheet and
sterilization compatibility chart.

Technical Description: The AquaLine 4H-Pro is an air-driven, high speed
(4-hole) system fitting Midwest 4-hole handpieces, using autoclavable
tubing for a sterile delivery pathway. The kit includes one 16 ounce
autoclavable bottle rather than the standard two-bottle configuration,
providing equivalent total irrigation capacity in a single reservoir.
The waterline system detaches fully from the handpiece body for
independent sterilization. The full unit is described as fully
autoclavable to ensure sterility between uses, and it is designed to
provide high-speed cutting power rivaling electric handpieces while
maintaining precision and responsiveness. Irrigation is controlled with
a simple instant on/off mechanism and no added footprint. The AquaLine
4H-Pro integrates seamlessly with Midwest, DentalEZ, and A-dec delivery
systems without adapters, covering the majority of dental units in use
today.

Exhibit B Sterilization Compatibility Chart excerpt: "Note: the
handpiece connector housing is not autoclavable and should be cleaned
with hospital-grade disinfectant wipes only; all other components may
be autoclaved per the standard cycle."

prompt:
You are assessing whether a bidder's tender application satisfies a
specific requirement from the tender's requirements document.

Requirement:
The contractor must comply with the delivery frequencies specified per delivery location as outlined in Attachment A.

Relevant excerpts from the bidder's application:
[1] Price Schedule:
Attached is our fully priced Schedule of Items (Attachment C), covering
all 1,331 line items across all five ordering periods. Northern Plains
Medical Gases agrees to hold the prices in this offer firm for 90
calendar days from the date specified for receipt of offers.

Project Management Plan:
Our Project Management Plan assigns a single point of contact, Dana
Whitfield, who will coordinate onboarding, task order communications, and
identify and delineate the roles and responsibilities of our dispatch and
billing staff. Dana Whitfield is also responsible for ensuring contract
deliverables are provided on time. A preliminary delivery, install, and
user acceptance schedule is included as Appendix 1, showing task
dependencies and an estimate of how much time each critical task is
expected to take through the first 60 days of performance.

Cylinder Tracking:
For cylinders in transit to and from ordering activities, we will use a
barcode-based tracking system (method: handheld barcode scanners at
pickup and delivery, data stored in a cloud portal) that allows ordering
activity POCs on-demand access to view and extract delivery and location
data for all cylinders moving in and out of their facility.

We do not currently operate a system for tracking medical gas cylinders
within an ordering activity's facility after delivery, and are therefore
not submitting a facility-side tracking plan with this proposal.

[3] Cylinder Management: As described above under Cylinder Tracking, our
barcode-based tracking system represents an innovative use of cylinder
tracking and management technology across the ordering activity network.

Regulatory Compliance: All medical gases supplied under this contract
will conform to the specifications of the United States Pharmacopoeia and
National Formulary, and our gas manufacturing and filling partners are
registered with the U.S. Food and Drug Administration.

Past Performance:
Contract/Project: VISN 23 Medical Gas Supply IDIQ, Fargo VA Medical
Center. Period of Performance: 2021-2024. Description: cylinder gas
delivery and rental services for a multi-building VA medical campus.
Agency/Facility: Department of Veterans Affairs, Fargo VA Medical Center.
Point of Contact: Marcus Ellingson, Contracting Officer Representative,
(701) 555-0122, marcus.ellingson@va.gov.

Transition / Phase-In Strategy:
Our phase-in strategy includes a Project Communications Plan identifying
Dana Whitfield as the point of contact for all phase-in and ongoing
contract communications, along with the roles of our dispatch and billing
staff who will support this contract through the period of performance.
We will also submit an Implementation Plan describing depot staffing and
cylinder-inventory buildup during the phase-in period.

[2] We do not currently operate a system for tracking medical gas cylinders
within an ordering activity's facility after delivery, and are therefore
not submitting a facility-side tracking plan with this proposal.

Reporting Capabilities:
Northern Plains Medical Gases will provide on-demand usage, cost, and
cylinder-tracking reports through the same cloud portal referenced above,
covering actual and average deliveries by week, month, and year and by
gas type; actual and average billing data by week, month, and year per
medical gas; and perpetual delivery, pick-up, and location data per
cylinder. Reports will be viewable through the web portal or exported to
an Excel spreadsheet upon request.

Technical Capability:

Operational Capability: Northern Plains Medical Gases has operated a
medical-gas cylinder delivery and rental fleet serving VA and civilian
hospital systems across North Dakota, Minnesota, and Iowa for eleven
years and is fully capable of meeting the requirements of the Statement
of Work described in this solicitation.

Continuity of Operations: In the event of a supply-chain interruption, we
maintain backup supply agreements with two independent industrial gas
fillers and can reroute deliveries from our Sioux Falls depot within 24
hours of a disruption at any other location.

[4] Veterans Involvement / Limitations on Subcontracting:
Northern Plains Medical Gases will perform 100% of the work identified in
the Statement of Work and Contract Administration with its own personnel
and equipment; no subcontractors, similarly situated entities, or other
performing parties are proposed. As we are not proposing to use any
subcontractors and are not a large business electing SDVOSB/VOSB
subcontractor credit, we have not included a VAAR 852.219-76 Certificate
of Compliance with this submission.

No amendments to this solicitation had been issued as of the date of this
quote.

Note: Item pricing for four specialty gas mixture line items in the
Schedule of Items remains pending confirmation from our upstream supplier
and will be provided by change order shortly after award.

Please contact us with any questions regarding this quote.

Sincerely,
Dana Whitfield
Contracts Manager
Northern Plains Medical Gases, LLC

Subject: Quote for Solicitation 36C26326Q0197 - Medical Cylinder Gases IDIQ

Solicitation Number: 36C26326Q0197

Northern Plains Medical Gases, LLC
2200 19th Ave N
Fargo, ND 58102
(701) 555-0184
Unique Entity Identifier: NP7Q3RXK9M12

Northern Plains Medical Gases, LLC is registered and active in the System
for Award Management (SAM) as of the date of this quote.

Northern Plains Medical Gases, LLC certifies it is a certified
Service-Disabled Veteran-Owned Small Business listed in the SBA Veteran
Small Business Certification Program database.

Depots and Delivery:
Northern Plains Medical Gases operates staffed depots in Fargo, ND and
Sioux Falls, SD, with a satellite dispatch point in Minneapolis, MN,
placing resources within each of the geographic areas served under this
solicitation. We commit to complying with the delivery frequency
specified per location in Attachment A for all seven facility groups.
All specialty and bulk medical gases offered under this contract are
sourced through an exclusive regional supply agreement with a single
filler, Prairie Industrial Gas Co., which ensures consistent quality
control across all deliveries.

[4] Veterans Involvement / Limitations on Subcontracting:
Northern Plains Medical Gases will perform 100% of the work identified in
the Statement of Work and Contract Administration with its own personnel
and equipment; no subcontractors, similarly situated entities, or other
performing parties are proposed. As we are not proposing to use any
subcontractors and are not a large business electing SDVOSB/VOSB
subcontractor credit, we have not included a VAAR 852.219-76 Certificate
of Compliance with this submission.

No amendments to this solicitation had been issued as of the date of this
quote.

Note: Item pricing for four specialty gas mixture line items in the
Schedule of Items remains pending confirmation from our upstream supplier
and will be provided by change order shortly after award.

Please contact us with any questions regarding this quote.

Sincerely,
Dana Whitfield
Contracts Manager
Northern Plains Medical Gases, LLC

[1] Price Schedule:
Attached is our fully priced Schedule of Items (Attachment C), covering
all 1,331 line items across all five ordering periods. Northern Plains
Medical Gases agrees to hold the prices in this offer firm for 90
calendar days from the date specified for receipt of offers.

Project Management Plan:
Our Project Management Plan assigns a single point of contact, Dana
Whitfield, who will coordinate onboarding, task order communications, and
identify and delineate the roles and responsibilities of our dispatch and
billing staff. Dana Whitfield is also responsible for ensuring contract
deliverables are provided on time. A preliminary delivery, install, and
user acceptance schedule is included as Appendix 1, showing task
dependencies and an estimate of how much time each critical task is
expected to take through the first 60 days of performance.

Cylinder Tracking:
For cylinders in transit to and from ordering activities, we will use a
barcode-based tracking system (method: handheld barcode scanners at
pickup and delivery, data stored in a cloud portal) that allows ordering
activity POCs on-demand access to view and extract delivery and location
data for all cylinders moving in and out of their facility.

We do not currently operate a system for tracking medical gas cylinders
within an ordering activity's facility after delivery, and are therefore
not submitting a facility-side tracking plan with this proposal.

[3] Cylinder Management: As described above under Cylinder Tracking, our
barcode-based tracking system represents an innovative use of cylinder
tracking and management technology across the ordering activity network.

Regulatory Compliance: All medical gases supplied under this contract
will conform to the specifications of the United States Pharmacopoeia and
National Formulary, and our gas manufacturing and filling partners are
registered with the U.S. Food and Drug Administration.

Past Performance:
Contract/Project: VISN 23 Medical Gas Supply IDIQ, Fargo VA Medical
Center. Period of Performance: 2021-2024. Description: cylinder gas
delivery and rental services for a multi-building VA medical campus.
Agency/Facility: Department of Veterans Affairs, Fargo VA Medical Center.
Point of Contact: Marcus Ellingson, Contracting Officer Representative,
(701) 555-0122, marcus.ellingson@va.gov.

Transition / Phase-In Strategy:
Our phase-in strategy includes a Project Communications Plan identifying
Dana Whitfield as the point of contact for all phase-in and ongoing
contract communications, along with the roles of our dispatch and billing
staff who will support this contract through the period of performance.
We will also submit an Implementation Plan describing depot staffing and
cylinder-inventory buildup during the phase-in period.

[2] We do not currently operate a system for tracking medical gas cylinders
within an ordering activity's facility after delivery, and are therefore
not submitting a facility-side tracking plan with this proposal.

Reporting Capabilities:
Northern Plains Medical Gases will provide on-demand usage, cost, and
cylinder-tracking reports through the same cloud portal referenced above,
covering actual and average deliveries by week, month, and year and by
gas type; actual and average billing data by week, month, and year per
medical gas; and perpetual delivery, pick-up, and location data per
cylinder. Reports will be viewable through the web portal or exported to
an Excel spreadsheet upon request.

Technical Capability:

Operational Capability: Northern Plains Medical Gases has operated a
medical-gas cylinder delivery and rental fleet serving VA and civilian
hospital systems across North Dakota, Minnesota, and Iowa for eleven
years and is fully capable of meeting the requirements of the Statement
of Work described in this solicitation.

Continuity of Operations: In the event of a supply-chain interruption, we
maintain backup supply agreements with two independent industrial gas
fillers and can reroute deliveries from our Sioux Falls depot within 24
hours of a disruption at any other location.
